asi.method: median of 15 cold subprocess reps after 3 warmup, in-script
asi.env_parity: worktree of primary checkout; no repo traversal on query path (unlike drift-scan session) so worktree does not hide the import mechanism; macOS, py3.14.7 Homebrew
asi.decomposition: 46.45 = ~14.6 interpreter floor + ~19 module imports (urllib.request 14.0 + tempfile 6.3 of 23.0 importtime tree) + ~2 logic
asi.noise: discovery block-median spread 4.1ms, stdev 1.97ms; session judged medians-only (gate label borderline)
asi.pins: models=9, sha_ok=1, cache rsynced from primary each run

description: defer urllib.request to _default_fetcher and tempfile to _write_json_atomic (function-level imports)

asi.hypothesis: expect ~-15ms because urllib.request (14.0ms importtime cumulative) and tempfile (6.3ms) drop out of module import; both used only by network fetch and cache write, off the offline read path
asi.result: -12.36ms (-26.6%): 46.45 -> 34.09 median-of-15; win = 6.2x in-session spread (1.99ms), 3.0x discovery stdev (1.97ms)
asi.learning: prototype in /tmp measured 31.8 — worktree/primary location adds ~2ms cold-start vs /tmp (same code, same data); /tmp-vs-repo FS layout matters for cold-start, so cross-location comparisons are approximate; within-session ruler is authoritative
